A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Language Models. All 24 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.14, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original guessing-game experiments, including 7,150 preliminary experiments, 600 main GPT-4.1 experiments, and additional model evaluations and robustness analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the main coordination analyses, additional model results in Table A2, and persona-effect analyses in Appendix A.14.

M1.justification: The information-theoretic framework, hierarchical models, and Plain, Persona, and Persona+ToM interventions are unchanged. The Qwen prompt safeguard in Appendix A.13 was already present in v2; moving intervention and estimation descriptions does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same simulated group sum-guessing task with high/low feedback and no direct agent communication. No dataset, task, domain, or distinct evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same three intervention conditions and deterministic binary-search functional baseline participate in the corresponding analyses. The newly cited failure-related papers in Appendix A.13 are contextual references, not newly evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Group sizes, temperatures, model configurations, evaluation measures, two- and three-bin discretization, and early-synergy horizons remain unchanged. The estimation settings relocated within Section 2 describe the same protocols.

E4.justification: The appendices retain the same alternative estimators, null models, binning sensitivity tests, identity-persistence analyses, early-synergy tests, and persona analyses. Qwen's failure taxonomy and illustrative cases are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Replication counts, seed-independence statements, permutation counts, confidence intervals, and statistical tests are retained. Section 4.1 changes 'individual' to 'overall' when describing the combined Fisher test, clarifying the existing analysis without changing uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: Reported numerical and qualitative outcomes remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Section 4.3 retains the synergy–redundancy interaction coefficient 0.24 with p=0.014, and Table A2 retains Qwen success rates of 51%, 71%, and 58% across the three conditions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3), hierarchical-model specifications, and mathematical definitions are unchanged. Removing 'the macro captures' from the explanation of pairwise synergy clarifies the existing joint-future target without revising the mathematical criterion or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, research questions, four stated contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about measuring and steering emergent coordination. Neither version claims to establish team-over-solo superiority on this task.

C2.justification: Appendix A.13 strengthens the characterization of Qwen's nontermination from 'unresolved ambiguity' to 'irreducible epistemic uncertainty about others.' This is a localized refinement of the failure explanation; the taxonomy, examples, and principal limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The prompt templates, persona-generation recipe, model identifiers, API and hardware disclosures, Qwen safeguard, and replication-code link are retained. Consolidating estimator descriptions does not add or remove substantive reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Appendix A.13 adds citations to Cemri et al. (2025), Duan et al. (2026), and Shapira et al. (2026, Agents of Chaos), connecting the existing discussion to multi-agent failures and circular reasoning. The broader positioning and novelty claims remain stable.

P1.justification: v4 moves the intervention descriptions from Section 3.2 into Section 2, consolidates estimator, binning, and lag descriptions under Entropy Estimation, removes repetition, and corrects scattered wording. The overall section structure and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Minor page reflow moves Equation (1) from page 3 to page 4, shifts Table A2 within page 23, and redistributes bibliography entries. Figures 1–3 and A1–A2 and Tables A1–A2 retain their designs, captions, and displayed content.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves clarity by introducing interventions earlier, consolidating estimation details, and correcting misleading wording around pairwise synergy. The added references give the existing Qwen failure discussion more context. The experimental evidence and principal limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to clearer exposition and contextualization.
